पति हो तो ऐसा! निक जोनास ने करवा चौथ पर प्रियंका चोपड़ा को दिया बेहद खूबसूरत सरप्राइज। 💖

29 October को प्रियंका चोपड़ा और Nick Jonas ने करवा चौथ मनाया और Instagram पर इस खास दिन की खूबसूरत तस्वीरें शेयर कीं।

प्रियंका ने बताया कि उनके बिना कहे ही Nick ने अपने tour का शेड्यूल इस तरह सेट किया ताकि वे करवा चौथ पर घर आ सकें।

Instagram पोस्ट में प्रियंका अपनी DIY मेहंदी, सिंदूरी रेड कुर्ता सेट में व्रत तोड़ते हुए और बेटी Malti को Nick से गले मिलते दिखा रही हैं।

बता दें कि इस कपल ने December 2018 में जोधपुर के उम्मेद भवन पैलेस में शादी की थी और January 2022 में सरोगेसी से बेटी Malti Marie का स्वागत किया था।

फिल्मों की बात करें तो प्रियंका जल्द ही SS Rajamouli की फिल्म Varanasi में Mahesh Babu के साथ नजर आएंगी, जो Sankranthi 2027 में रिलीज होगी।

क्या आपको भी Nick Jonas का यह अंदाज पसंद आया? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇😍

ctx.title: Priyanka Chopra reveals Nick Jonas set his tour dates aside so that he could come home to celebrate Karwa Chauth with her
ctx.summary: Priyanka Chopra and singer Nick Jonas never miss a chance to dish out relationship goals, and Karwa Chauth was no exception.
ctx.text:
Priyanka Chopra and Nick Jonas marked the festival of Karwa Chauth on October 29 and shared pictures from the celebrations on Instagram. The actor shared how Nick made sure to spend the special day with her even though he is busy with his tour.
Priyanka shared a carousel of pictures on Instagram and wrote in the caption, "He can home without me asking him to.. knowing how much it would mean to mm and I.. he made sure tour was set up to be home for karwachauth.. 🥺
No one like my guy… May a love like this find you all.. happy karwachauth ❤️"
The actor showed her DIY mehndi design, her breaking the Karwa Chauth fast, Malti hugging Nick, and another showing her in a ceremonial red outfit. She wore a traditional sindoori red kurta set to break the Karwa Chauth fast she observed for her husband, Nick Jonas.
Karwa Chauth is a traditional Hindu festival where married women observe a strict, waterless fast (nirjala vrat) from sunrise to moonrise to pray for the longevity, safety, and well-being of their husbands. Observed this year on Thursday, October 29, the Karwa Chauth puja muhurat will last from 5:38 PM to 6:56 PM, according to Drik Panchang.
Priyanka and Nick made their relationship public only after they got engaged in July 2018. The couple tied the knot in a dreamy wedding involving both Christian and Hindu ceremonies at Jodhpur’s Umaid Bhawan Palace on 1 and 2 December 2018. In January 2022, the couple welcomed their first child, daughter Malti Marie, via surrogacy.
After films such as Mary Kom, Dil Dhadakne Do, Bajirao Mastani and Jai Gangaajal, Priyanka is all set to return to Indian cinema after years with SS Rajamouli’s Telugu film Varanasi, which also stars Mahesh Babu and Prithviraj Sukumaran. The film will be released in theatres for Sankranthi 2027. The film stars Mahesh Babu as Rudhra, Priyanka as Mandakini and Prithviraj as Kumbha.
